title: FabricMines
description: Simple BoxPvP and prison mine resets for Fabric, featuring mine selection, automatic regeneration, countdowns, and player safety features.
body:
# FabricMines

FabricMines is a lightweight Fabric mod that adds fully customizable BoxPvP and prison-style mine resets without requiring WorldEdit or any external plugins. Create mines using a simple in-game selection tool, save their original block layouts, and automatically regenerate them on a timer or through commands.

## Features

* Create and manage multiple mines.
* Automatic mine regeneration on configurable timers.
* Manual mine reset commands.
* No WorldEdit dependency required.
* Built-in region selection using a Warped Fungus on a Stick.
* Stores and restores every block in a mine region.
* Countdown warnings before resets.
* Safe player evacuation before regeneration.
* Simple Fabric-only installation.

## Region Selection

Use the `/mine wand` command to receive a Mine Selection Tool (Warped Fungus on a Stick).

* Right-click a block to set Position 1.
* Shift + Right-click a block to set Position 2.
* Create a mine from the selected region.

No WorldEdit, schematics, or external tools are required.

## Commands

* `/mine wand` - Receive the Mine Selection Tool.
* `/mine create <id> <reset_time>` - Create and save a mine.
* `/mine reset <id>` - Reset a mine immediately.
* `/mine delete <id>` - Delete a mine.
* `/mine list` - View all registered mines.

## Mine Reset Warnings

To prevent players from being trapped during regeneration, FabricMines includes a built-in warning system.

Example countdown:

* 15 seconds remaining
* 10 seconds remaining
* 5...
* 4...
* 3...
* 2...
* 1...

Players inside the mine receive notifications and can safely leave before the reset occurs.

## Safe Teleportation

When the countdown reaches zero, any players still inside the mine can be automatically teleported to a safe location before the mine regenerates. This prevents suffocation, clipping into blocks, and other issues that commonly occur during mine resets.

## Designed For

* BoxPvP Servers
* Prison Servers
* SkyPrison Servers
* Economy Servers
* Survival Servers with regenerating resource mines

## Why FabricMines?

Many mine reset systems rely on plugins or complex WorldEdit integrations. FabricMines was built specifically for Fabric servers and focuses on simplicity, performance, and ease of setup. Define a region, save it, set a timer, and let the mod handle the rest.

Simple. Lightweight. Fabric-native.
